title: Proposal to Make Public Data on Complaints of Unfair Employment Practices
what_it_is: Proposal to Make Public Data on Complaints of Unfair Employment Practices

sections.label: TAFEP and MOM complaints
sections.summary: TAFEP and MOM received an average of 450 complaints a year between 2015 and 2017, mostly unfair consideration for Singaporeans or age discrimination.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: TAFEP and the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) received 450 such complaints a year on average between 2015 and 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The vast majority of complaints are claims of unfair consideration for Singaporeans or age discrimination.

sections.label: MOM enforcement and publicity
sections.summary: MOM takes enforcement actions including curtailing work pass privileges, and may publicise cases of public interest or egregious conduct, though naming all errant employers could breach employees' privacy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM takes enforcement actions against such employers, including curtailing their work pass privileges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM and TAFEP will consider publicising cases in situations of public interest or where the conduct is egregious, as we have done so in the past.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, while naming all errant employers publicly would serve as a deterrent, there could be unintended consequences, such as indirectly identifying the affected employees and breaching their privacy.

sections.label: Action against 521 companies
sections.summary: From 2013 to 2017, MOM investigated and took action against 521 companies for discriminatory employment practices, with 300 warned and 221 having work pass privileges curtailed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In fact, to assure Members that action has been taken, from 2013 to 2017, MOM investigated, and we took action against 521 companies for discriminatory employment practices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Among the 521 companies, 300 or 58% received warnings, and 221 or 42% had their work pass privileges curtailed.

sections.label: Publicity question and complaint statistics
sections.summary: The Member's question relates to publicity, so statistics from when TAFEP was conceived are unavailable, but there were 450 complaints a year on average between 2015 and 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The Member's question relates to publicity, so I do not have the statistics from the time TAFEP was conceived.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But as stated in my earlier reply, there has been 450 complaints a year on average between 2015 and 2017.
